description:
THE GREAT ELEPHANT TALE follows three elephant herds in different African environments; the lush abundance of the Okavango delta, the wilds of the remote Lower Zambezi valley and the harsh terrain of the Hoanib Desert. A mother guides her family to find food and shelter, a calf navigates the dangers of her new environment and a bull pursues a breeding herd to extend his bloodline. The three narratives intertwine as we compare the challenges faced by the same species...
Producer: Merx International
一个特别的大象家族因为某种原因开启了他们的迁徙之路，这位女族长带领她的家人穿过沙漠与河流，为了寻找下一个家，这路上他们都经历了哪些光怪陆离？这里讲述了非洲大草原上具有标志性的家族的故事。
1期全：“女族长”带领家族横穿沙漠 非洲野犬围攻大象彻底被激怒
